topics.title: Dolphins
topics.description: Dolphins are highly intelligent marine mammals known for their playful behavior.
facts: Dolphins can recognize themselves in mirrors.
They use echolocation to navigate and hunt.
Some dolphins can swim up to 20 mph.

topics.title: Great White Shark
topics.description: The great white shark is one of the ocean's most formidable predators.
facts: Great whites can detect one drop of blood in 25 gallons of water.
They can grow up to 20 feet long.
Their teeth are constantly replaced throughout their lives.
